rules: Preset houses; free-place interior/exterior objects; NO modular walls/floors/roof
No required recipe may depend on a randomized exclusive loot drop

unlockCodes.MAT:ITEM_ID: Knowledge gained from first acquiring this item
unlockCodes.STATION:BUILD_ID: Knowledge gained from first placing this station
unlockCodes.BP:BP_ID: Obtained guaranteed blueprint at fixed POI
unlockCodes.STORY:FLAG: Unlocked by world/story state, not random loot

notes: Items include intermediates, raw sources, food, tools, seeds and special story items; actual per-biome source respawns are RegionDB responsibility.
Crops receive seeds via world loot/harvest, not through crafting recipes.
World-gathered fish become raw fish portions plus fish offcuts via catch-processing logic; fish species remain in FishDB.
All outputType=upgrade recipes modify an existing building without spawning another object; R_SEA_CHEST is outputType=build.
Construction recipes are total costs; stages are UI/visual subdivisions, not extra costs.
Some IDs are provisional; all cross references in this draft are validated.
